name: MacX DVD Ripper Pro
product: MacX DVD Ripper Pro by Digiarty Software

evidence.says: Digiarty's update page explicitly says that MacX DVD Ripper Pro 6.9.0 added native Apple Silicon support on June 4, 2026.

notes: The product shares a similar bundle identifier with MacX Video Converter Pro, a separate application.

name: WD Security Installer
product: Western Digital WD Security Installer and Uninstaller

evidence.says: Western Digital documents WD Security Installer as the setup program that installs the separate WD Security application.
The cask identifies WD Security Installer and WD Security Uninstaller separately from the installed WD Security app.

notes: The installer and uninstaller share this listing; WD Security itself has its own entry.

name: Review Manager 5.4
product: Cochrane Review Manager 5.4 (RevMan 5 desktop)

evidence.says: Cochrane retired RevMan 5 on April 25, 2023 and replaced it with RevMan Web.
Cochrane advised desktop users to install RevMan 5.4.1 in September 2020.
Cochrane's current software reference guide identifies RevMan 5 as no longer supported.

limitation: The architecture and exact release date of the last documented desktop build were not verified.
notes: RevMan Web is the replacement.

name: WD Security
product: Western Digital WD Security for Mac

evidence.says: Western Digital says WD Security requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon Macs.
Homebrew identifies the vendor's current Mac download as 2.1.6.434 and includes a Rosetta requirement.
I inspected WD Security.app/Contents/MacOS/WD Security in the official ZIP's nested installer payload and verified the exact 2.1.6.434 bundle is x86_64 only.

limitation: The build release date was not verified.

name: Adobe AIR Application Installer
product: Adobe AIR Application Installer, the Adobe AIR background helper for .air packages

evidence.says: The scanned v30.0 bundle declares the .air document type and is marked LSBackgroundOnly.
Adobe documents the AIR application install handler as part of the desktop AIR runtime workflow.

notes: This helper is part of Adobe AIR and should not be tracked separately from the runtime.

name: Adobe AIR Installer
product: Adobe AIR Installer and Uninstaller, the Adobe AIR runtime maintenance utility

evidence.says: The scanned v30.0 background-only bundle uses the executable name Adobe AIR Installer and is also listed as Adobe AIR Uninstaller.
Adobe documents the Adobe AIR Uninstaller in Applications/Utilities as the removal tool for the AIR runtime.

notes: The scanned filename is Adobe AIR Uninstaller.app.zip.

name: MacMorpheus
product: MacMorpheus, the 180/360-degree PSVR video player by emoRaivis

evidence.says: GitHub marks 0.2 as the latest release, and inspection of its MacMorpheus.app.zip asset found only x86_64 in MacMorpheus.app/Contents/MacOS/MacMorpheus.
The release metadata dates 0.2 to October 26, 2016.

limitation: No credible Rosetta 2 test or current Apple Silicon compatibility statement was found.

name: SensibleSideButtons
product: SensibleSideButtons by archagon (Alexei Baboulevitch)

evidence.says: The maintainer marks 1.0.7 as the latest release and says it was recompiled for both Apple Silicon and Intel.

notes: SaneSideButtons is a separate fork.

name: iGlance
product: iGlance menu bar system monitor by the iGlance project

evidence.says: The latest official release is v2.1.0, and I inspected its ZIP and found iGlance.app/Contents/MacOS/iGlance to be an x86_64-only Mach-O.
A first-hand report shows iGlance running through Rosetta 2 on an M1 MacBook Air and displaying inaccurate sensor data.
A second user identifies iGlance 2.1 running on an M1 Mac with macOS Monterey 12.1 and shows the same CPU temperature issue.

limitation: Users reported incorrect CPU temperature and fan readings on Apple Silicon.
notes: The downloaded bundle has io.github.iglance.iGlance and reports version 2.1 internally.

name: Neo4j Desktop
product: Neo4j Desktop by Neo4j

evidence.says: Neo4j lists Desktop 2.3.2 as released November 24, 2026 and offers a universal Mac disk image for the current 2.x release.
Neo4j publishes release notes specifically for Desktop 2.3.2.

name: Alchemy
product: Alchemy Viewer for Second Life by the Alchemy Viewer project

evidence.says: The official Alchemy Project Quantum 26.5.1.45122247509 prerelease provides an arm64 macOS disk image.
The previous Alchemy Beta 7.1.9.2516 release lists an x86_64 macOS disk image.

limitation: Apple Silicon native support is verified for the experimental Quantum prerelease channel.
notes: The regular Alchemy Beta channel's most recent Mac image is still Intel.

name: EOS Lens Registration Tool
product: EOS Lens Registration Tool by Canon, a component distributed with EOS Utility

evidence.says: Canon lists the enclosing EOS Utility 3.21.11 download and its October 9, 2026 publication date.

Inspection of the ELRT-M1.21.10.pkg payload confirmed the listing's bundle ID, version 1.21.10 and both x86_64 and arm64 slices in EOS Lens Registration Tool.app/Contents/MacOS/EOS Lens Registration Tool.

notes: The date refers to the enclosing EOS Utility distribution.

name: PictureStyleEditor
product: Picture Style Editor by Canon

evidence.says: Canon dates the current 1.33.10 macOS download October 9, 2026 and documents when native Apple Silicon support was introduced in 1.31.20.
Inspection of the official 1.33.10 package payload confirmed the listing's bundle ID and both x86_64 and arm64 slices in PictureStyleEditor.app/Contents/MacOS/PictureStyleEditor.

name: OSX Validate All AUs
product: OSX Validate All AUs, a user-saved Apple Script Editor applet

evidence.says: The submitted bundle identifies itself as com.apple.ScriptEditor.id.OSX-Validate-All-AUs and its executable is named applet.
Apple documents saving scripts as application bundles in Script Editor.

limitation: No separately released product or vendor download was identified.
notes: The upload represents a Script Editor automation for validating audio units.

name: Application Stub
product: Ocultar Archivos Ocultos, an Apple Automator workflow bundled as an application stub

evidence.says: The uploaded bundle identifies itself in the com.apple.automator namespace under Ocultar Archivos Ocultos and names its executable Application Stub.

notes: The name refers to hiding hidden files in Finder.

name: Epson Ink Replenishment Agent
product: Seiko Epson Ink Replenishment Agent, the ReadyInk printer-monitoring component

evidence.says: Epson lists ReadyInk Agent 1.0.5 among its bundled Mac printer utilities, matching the version in the scanned entry.
Epson describes ReadyInk as an automatic replenishment service that monitors printer ink levels.

limitation: Epson's public documentation does not publish the agent's bundle identifier or CPU architecture.
notes: The scan identifies the component as com.epson.printermonitoringagent.

name: Epson Firmware Updater
product: Seiko Epson Firmware Updater for printer firmware packages

evidence.says: Epson's Mac instructions launch the Firmware Updater after Epson Software Updater downloads the selected hardware firmware update.
Epson publishes recovery firmware downloads for particular printer models.

notes: This is the flasher bundled with model-specific firmware releases. Epson Software Updater is the separate general-purpose app.

name: Logitech Unifying Software
product: Logitech Unifying Software for macOS

evidence.says: Logitech says it no longer supports or maintains Unifying Software and directs users with supported devices to Logi Options+.
Logitech lists 1.3.375 on August 23, 2018, and I inspected the official installer payload and found Logitech Unifying Software.app/Contents/MacOS/Logitech Unifying Software to be x86_64 only.

limitation: Rosetta 2 runtime behavior was not verified.
notes: The inspected app matches com.logitech.unifying.assistant and reports version 1.3.375.

name: LogMeIn Hamachi
product: GoTo LogMeIn Hamachi for Mac

evidence.says: The official download page links to the ZIP whose embedded payload I inspected, where LogMeIn Hamachi.app/Contents/MacOS/LogMeIn Hamachi is universal with x86_64 and arm64 slices.
GoTo's community representative confirms Mac version 2.3.0.82 is available from VPN.net and supports macOS 27.

limitation: The release was confirmed by October 1, 2026, and its exact release day was not verified.
notes: The installed bundle matches com.logmein.hamachi and reports build 2.3.0.82 and short version 2.3.82. The Homebrew lead pointed to an older build.

name: TuritoWhiteboard
product: TuritoWhiteboard, a Turito-branded Tencent interactive classroom bundle

evidence.says: The listing's scanned Info.plist identifies TuritoWhiteboard 1.7.14 as com.tencent.ilivesdk-tcic with Tencent copyright.
Turito hosts a Whiteboard web entry point without a public Mac release or architecture listing.
Tencent documents a Mac desktop SDK and external client launch for its interactive classroom service.

limitation: The scanned Tencent bundle could not be matched to a current official Turito Mac download or confirmed to be a standalone app.

name: VStitcher
product: Browzwear VStitcher garment design and simulation software

evidence.says: Browzwear explicitly documents native Apple Silicon support for VStitcher 2023.2.1, build 53519.
Browzwear still distributes the verified 2023.2.1 Mac build alongside its newer 2026.3.0 release.
Browzwear's current requirements recommend an M1 or newer processor for VStitcher on macOS.

limitation: 2023.2.1 is the named build with explicit native documentation, and the 2026.3.0 disk image architecture was not independently verified.

name: 3DCoat
product: Pilgway 3DCoat for macOS

evidence.says: Pilgway offers Mac builds of 3DCoat 2026 without a CPU architecture label.
Pilgway's Mac developer download page lists 3DCoat 2026.30 without specifying its architecture.
Pilgway developer Sergyi explicitly called the 2023.29 Mac build universal.
A 2024 official forum discussion quotes the developer explaining that a later Mac build was Intel-only because of the AngelScript dependency.

limitation: The architecture of the currently offered Mac builds could not be tied to a named version, and the 2026.30 package exceeded the binary-inspection size limit.
notes: Historical Mac builds have differed in architecture. The vendor's explicitly universal 2023.29 build remains hosted, but the claim cannot be carried forward to newer versions.

name: Amadeus Pro
product: Amadeus Pro 2 by HairerSoft

evidence.says: HairerSoft’s App Store release notes identify 2.8.15 as the last Amadeus Pro 2 release and direct customers to version 3.
Apple identifies 2.8.15 as the current version of the exact com.HairerSoft.AmadeusPro bundle, released August 14, 2026.
HairerSoft says native support starts with version 3.0 and keeps version 2.8.14 available as an older download.
The official v2.8.14 ZIP contains the exact listing bundle with an Intel x86_64 Contents/MacOS/Amadeus Pro executable.
The official version 3.0.4 ZIP has a universal Contents/MacOS/Amadeus Pro 3 executable in the distinct com.HairerSoft.AmadeusPro3 bundle.

limitation: The final Mac App Store 2.8.15 executable was not directly inspected.
notes: The Intel v2 product remains listed in the Mac App Store. The successor Amadeus Pro 3 uses a separate bundle ID.

name: Auralia 5 Student
product: Auralia 5 Student Edition by Rising Software

evidence.says: Rising Software documents Auralia 5.0.18.50, a later v5 update than the scanned version, without specifying CPU architecture or the Student bundle.
Rising Software lists macOS Catalina compatibility for fully updated Auralia 5.
The vendor's standalone download flow requires a serial number before delivering an installer.

limitation: The latest distributable Auralia 5 Student build and its architecture could not be established.
notes: The vendor also offers newer Auralia major versions under different product generations.

name: 1cestartt
product: 1cestartt, the starter component of 1C:Enterprise Training Edition by 1C-Soft

evidence.says: The scanned Mac bundle identifies the exact 1cestartt executable and 1C-Soft as the publisher.
The 1C executable reference identifies 1cestartt as the Training Edition starter and lists the interactive launcher and client as separate executables.
1C distributes the Training Edition as a complete macOS platform package.

limitation: The starter binary in the current Training Edition installer was not inspected.
notes: If listing the training platform itself, establish its compatibility separately.

name: UNDERTALE
product: Unidentified NW.js bundle labeled UNDERTALE

evidence.says: The submitted bundle identifies itself as the generic io.nwjs.nw wrapper and its executable as nwjs, with the version string 8.0 patched.
The file inventory for Toby Fox's official Steam macOS depot identifies a different main binary at UNDERTALE.app/Contents/MacOS/Mac_Runner.

limitation: The source or distributor of the scanned wrapper could not be established.
notes: The Homebrew NW.js entry is for the generic runtime; a listing for Toby Fox's official game needs independent verification.

name: A Short Hike
product: A Short Hike by Adam Robinson-Yu (adamgryu)

evidence.says: The developer lists a current macOS download labeled 1.12.2, with a 232 MB archive.
The installed-file ARM64 inventory marks the Steam edition as verified without specifying its build or version.
Steam depot metadata identifies public Steam build 20289045 and a separate beta build.

limitation: The available architecture result is unversioned, so it could not be tied to a specific Steam or itch.io release.
notes: The unversioned Steam ARM64 result makes this a strong candidate for confirmation on a Mac.

name: HiM
product: HiM (Hidden Cleaner iMproved) by Fernando Iazeolla

evidence.says: The historical catalog records HiM 1.4 from March 17, 2015 as Intel 64-bit, matches the scanned bundle ID, and points to the original download host.
The archived app entry identifies Fernando Iazeolla as the developer of this drag-and-drop USB and folder cleaner.

limitation: The original release host did not load, no maintained distribution surfaced, and a formal vendor retirement notice was not found.
notes: The last cataloged build is Intel-only according to MacUpdate.

name: Planner 5D
product: Planner 5D - AI Home Design for macOS by Planner5D, UAB

evidence.says: Planner 5D offers a dedicated Mac app through the Mac App Store.
Apple's lookup confirms the exact macOS bundle identifier and lists version 5.19.0 released November 23, 2026.

limitation: The vendor and store do not state the CPU architecture of the current Mac app.
notes: The separate iOS store listing does not establish architecture for this Mac bundle.

name: WebPViewer
product: WebP Viewer: quick look & view by Langui.net

evidence.says: Langui identifies the exact WebP Viewer Mac App Store listing.
The developer's version history says 1.1 added Apple Silicon support and 1.1.1 updated the macOS 27 app icon.
Apple's lookup confirms the exact Langui bundle identifier and dates version 1.1.1 November 4, 2026.

limitation: The developer says Apple Silicon is supported but gives no architecture, and the current executable was unavailable for inspection.
notes: The Infokom WebPView app is a different product.

name: yKey
product: yKey Legacy by Plum Amazing

evidence.says: Plum Amazing lists original yKey 2.9.5 separately from the rewritten yKey distribution.
Plum Amazing explicitly calls the original Objective-C yKey app end-of-life.
The official legacy ZIP contains the exact com.plumamazing.ykey bundle at 2.9.5 and its Contents/MacOS/yKey executable is x86_64 only.
The original yKey manual documents Apple Silicon use through Rosetta 2.

notes: The legacy download remains available. The universal yKey 3.0.2 rewrite uses the distinct com.plumamazing.ykeypro identifier.

name: TranslateIt!
product: TranslateIt! Deluxe Mac dictionary by Deep IT

evidence.says: The original scan identifies ru.DeepIT.TranslateIt as TranslateIt! Deluxe at version 14.1, build 14101, with Intel architecture metadata.
MacUpdate identifies the corresponding 14.1.0.1 build as Intel 32-bit and 64-bit, dates its update to February 1, 2012, and says the developer no longer supports it.

limitation: The original vendor site could not be reached to independently confirm the last build or its release date.

name: Configurador FNMT
product: Configurador FNMT-RCM by Fábrica Nacional de Moneda y Timbre–Real Casa de la Moneda

evidence.says: FNMT lists its current certificate key-generation utility for macOS and still gives Rosetta setup instructions for Macs with an M-series chip.
The package payload identifies the exact 5.1.3 bundle and its Contents/MacOS/Configurador FNMT executable contains x86_64 and arm64 slices.

limitation: The app was not run, so it is unclear whether any workflows still use Rosetta.
notes: The same package also contains an arm64 Java runtime library.

name: JLab Work
product: JLab Work by JLab, the desktop keyboard and mouse configuration utility

evidence.says: JLab offers a Mac download for its Work keyboard and mouse configuration app.
The vendor-linked package payload contains com.jlab.jlabwork v2.1 build 5, and Contents/MacOS/JLab Work has arm64 and x86_64 slices.

notes: The separately listed JLab Lab App supports other JLab hardware.

name: Angeldust
product: Angeldust for macOS by Frank Lucas and Metagaming B.V.

evidence.says: Apple’s lookup data matches the exact Mac App Store bundle to Metagaming B.V. and Mac version 3.37, released October 23, 2026.
The developer distinguishes the Mac App Store build from its iOS app and lists additional Mac downloads.
Metagaming lists a 385 MB standalone Mac 3.37 download without stating its CPU architecture.

limitation: The current Mac App Store Mach-O architecture and Apple Silicon runtime behavior remain unverified.

name: MacX Video Converter Pro
product: MacX Video Converter Pro by Digiarty Software

evidence.says: Digiarty says MacX Video Converter Pro is no longer maintained and directs customers to the separate Macxvideo AI product.
The still-reachable legacy DMG contains the exact 6.9.0 bundle, build 20250522, with an x86_64-only Contents/MacOS/MacX Video Converter Pro executable.

notes: Digiarty has withdrawn the promoted download even though its old direct URL still responds.

name: FotoMagico 5
product: FotoMagico 5 by Boinx Software

evidence.says: Boinx moved ongoing updates to the FotoMagico 6 product and requires a major upgrade from previous versions.
Boinx’s matching FotoMagico 5 release notes identify version 5.6.14 and November 27, 2020.
Boinx’s forum identifies FotoMagico 5 as no longer being developed, and Boinx staff discuss the M1 work in the newer product.
Boinx says FotoMagico 5 is unsupported on M1 and a customer reports the Intel release 5.6.14 working under Rosetta with an HEVC limitation.
The scanner’s v5.6.14 record for com.boinx.FotoMagico5 lists only the Intel architecture.

notes: The Intel-only v5 line has been replaced by Apple Silicon-capable FotoMagico 6.

name: EPOMAKER Driver
product: EPOMAKER Driver 2.x by EPOMAKER, the keyboard configuration app

evidence.says: EPOMAKER lists 2.1.90 as the macOS download for the original driver and names its supported keyboard models.
The official ZIP's DMG contains com.rongyuan.driverElectron at 2.1.90 with an x86_64-only Contents/MacOS/EPOMAKER Driver executable.
EPOMAKER publishes a separate Driver 3.0 download for a different set of hardware models.

limitation: No Rosetta result could be verified for version 2.1.90.

name: Cisdem Video Converter
product: Cisdem Video Converter, renamed Cisdem VideoPaw, by Cisdem

evidence.says: Cisdem records the name change at 10.0.0, full Apple Silicon support at 10.4.0, and release 11.1.0 on November 20, 2026.
The official DMG contains the unchanged com.cisdem.videoconverter bundle at 11.1.0, and Contents/MacOS/Cisdem VideoPaw has arm64 and x86_64 slices.

notes: Cisdem VideoPaw is the continued product under the same bundle ID.

name: Steuer St.Gallen 2023 nP
product: eTaxes 2023 for natural persons, published by the Canton of St.Gallen

evidence.says: The Cantonal Tax Office still offers eTaxes 2023 with distinct Intel and Mac M1/M2 downloads.
The M1/M2 installer payload contains the exact v1.4.0 com.install4j.6016-4451-6854-0741.2 app and its Contents/MacOS/JavaApplicationStub is arm64.

notes: Select the M1/M2 download. The release is specific to the 2023 tax period.
